executiveSummary: Dzisiejsza runda jest materialna. Just Join IT nadal pokazuje szeroki board AI/ML dla Wrocławia z 134 ofertami i dołożył świeży tail wokół agentic, platform i LLM work. Pracuj.pl odświeżył board o role z evaluation, agentic systems i AI automation, Comarch potwierdził żywy canonical DevOps Engineer (AI-native Stack) oraz Full-stack Developer (Agentic AI), a EPAM dodał Senior AI-Native Engineer, Senior AI & Agentic Systems Engineer (Java) i Senior .NET Engineer with AI z Wrocławiem w zasięgu hybrydy.

opportunities.title: AI Agent Middle/Senior Developer
opportunities.fitSummary: Python, RAG, CRAG, GraphRAG, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI i agentic tools.
opportunities.whyInteresting: To świeży board signal, który bardzo jasno siedzi w agentic retrieval i orchestration.
opportunities.uncertainty: Brak publicznego wynagrodzenia i pełnej kanoniczności employer page.

opportunities.title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
opportunities.fitSummary: Large Language Models, Agentic Evaluation, LLMOps, CI/CD, AWS i vector databases.
opportunities.whyInteresting: To mocny sygnał produkcyjnej platformy pod LLM i ewaluację agentów.
opportunities.uncertainty: Salary is undisclosed and the board card may keep drifting.

opportunities.title: Senior Data Scientist – AI/LLM Evaluation
opportunities.whyInteresting: Eval staje się coraz bardziej osobną kategorią na publicznych boardach.
opportunities.uncertainty: Employer page remains board-first in the current view.

opportunities.title: AI Engineer (Python, LLMs)
opportunities.whyInteresting: Silny, praktyczny sygnał hands-on LLM engineering z publiczną stawką.
opportunities.uncertainty: Board wording can still drift and the canonical page may change.

opportunities.title: Backend Engineer, AI Agent Systems
opportunities.whyInteresting: To nowy, explicit agentic systems lead z ciężarem backendowym.
opportunities.uncertainty: Employer page is still a public board card rather than a clearly canonical detail page.

opportunities.title: DevOps Engineer (AI-native Stack)
opportunities.fitSummary: AI-native architecture, AIOps, cloud and operational tooling.
opportunities.whyInteresting: Canonical page stays live and still anchors the more infra-heavy side of the topic.
opportunities.uncertainty: The role is broad and can skew toward platform engineering rather than pure LLM work.

opportunities.title: Full-stack Developer (Agentic AI)
opportunities.whyInteresting: This is a new canonical agentic-family signal on the Comarch seniors page.
opportunities.uncertainty: The seniors listing is broad, so the final day-to-day scope may be less AI-heavy than the title suggests.

opportunities.title: Senior AI-Native Engineer / Senior AI & Agentic Systems Engineer (Java)
opportunities.fitSummary: AI-native applications, agents, LLM-powered components and Java/Spring Boot delivery.
opportunities.whyInteresting: EPAM now has a cleaner canonical cluster around AI-native and agentic systems with Wrocław in scope.
opportunities.uncertainty: Titles are adjacent enough that future deduplication may be needed if one disappears or gets renamed.

opportunities.title: Senior .NET Engineer with AI
opportunities.fitSummary: AI-adjacent platform modernization, cloud, automation and delivery.
opportunities.whyInteresting: Not a pure LLM role, but it is a useful proxy for broader AI-enabled platform work at EPAM.
opportunities.uncertainty: The AI component may be lighter than the title implies.

changes: Just Join IT remained a large Wrocław AI/ML board, but the current surface now emphasizes agentic systems, platform evaluation and LLM infra more clearly than last run.
Pracuj.pl surfaced a stronger evaluation and agentic backend tail, including Senior Data Scientist – AI/LLM Evaluation, AI Engineer (Python, LLMs) and Backend Engineer, AI Agent Systems.
Comarch's canonical AI-native page stayed live, and the seniors page now exposes Full-stack Developer (Agentic AI) as an additional public family member.
EPAM added or re-surfaced a stronger Wrocław-hybrid canonical cluster around Senior AI-Native Engineer, Senior AI & Agentic Systems Engineer (Java) and Senior .NET Engineer with AI.
risks: Board-first offers can change title, salary or status quickly, so today's wording should be treated as a short-lived snapshot.
Some of the new roles are more platform, backend or evaluation-oriented than pure LLM engineering.
Full-stack Developer (Agentic AI) is public on Comarch's seniors page, but its actual AI depth may be narrower than the title suggests.
recommendedActions: Re-check the fresh Just Join IT, Pracuj.pl, Comarch and EPAM cards next run for expiry, salary drift and canonical-page emergence.
Watch whether Comarch's agentic family stays live and whether the new public Full-stack Developer (Agentic AI) keeps Wrocław wording.
Keep EPAM on the recurring shortlist because the new Wrocław-hybrid AI-native roles look stable enough to be worth repeated validation.
